Name: The Lorax Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
"I am the Lorax, I speak for the trees."

Welcome back to the valley, the Lorax! He hangs around the backwoods and judges humanity all day long.

This one came as a request to update and the author gave permission to update on their page, so here he is :)

JA and PFM dependencies have been removes so all you should need is Content Patcher and Alternative Textures if you want the truffula trees around the valley. There's a config to turn those on and off. You'll also want Custom NPC Exclusions to keep him from the orders randomization. He would never ask a human for a favor, after all.

This mod also changes mahogany trees to truffula trees. In a future update I'd like to figure out how to add them as their own trees but for now, this will do. Hardwood can be obtained from truffula trees, and if you run the hardwood through a bone mill, you'll get soft fluff, which can be turned into a thneed with a loom.

Enjoy!
